shop.brief: a small-batch coffee roaster in Porto with a subscription

theme.direction: warm editorial, cream paper, terracotta, slow mornings

shop.copy:
PAGE home "Lume Roasters — Home": the roaster and its subscription
  [hero] Roasted on Tuesdays / In your cup by Friday — Small batches from three farms, roasted to order in Porto.
  [plans] Two bags a month, 18 euros — Pause or skip any time.
PAGE beans "Lume Roasters — Beans": the three coffees
  [list] Three farms, three tastes — Yirgacheffe, Huila and Cerrado, each roasted light.
PAGE classes "Lume Roasters — Classes": Saturday brewing classes
  [hero] Learn to pour — Saturday mornings at the roastery, eight seats.
images: a hand pouring water over a V60 in morning light
burlap sacks of green coffee in a tiled Porto warehouse
a roaster drum with beans tumbling
two friends at a wooden counter with cups
a paper bag of coffee on a doorstep

event.brief: a weekend game jam in a harbour hall, 2027-03-20 to 21, 200 seats

theme.direction: riso zine, two inks, loud type, hand-cut shapes

event.copy:
PAGE home "Harbor Jam — Home": the jam and how to join
  [hero] 48 hours, one hall, 200 makers — March 20 to 21 at Harbor Hall, doors at nine.
  [how] Bring a laptop / Find a team / Ship by Sunday — Food and coffee all weekend.
PAGE schedule "Harbor Jam — Schedule": the weekend hour by hour
  [list] Theme at ten / Playtests at midnight / Showcase Sunday at six
PAGE tickets "Harbor Jam — Tickets": tickets
  [price] 25 dollars, students free — 200 seats, 61 left.

game.brief: a free rooftop runner: repair a relay on every stage and get home before the storm

theme.direction: 90s VHS anime, dusk rooftops, amber and ink blue

game.copy:
PAGE home "Rooftop Signal — Home": the game and its play button
  [hero] Run the roofs / Fix the signal — Six stages across the city, a relay to repair on each.
  [how] Jump, slide, grapple — One button each, a storm on your heels.
PAGE play "Rooftop Signal — Play": the game itself
  [hero] Stage 1: Laundry Lines
images: a courier girl mid-leap between rooftops at dusk, cel anime
a rusted relay tower with sparking wires
storm clouds rolling over a city skyline, VHS grain
the courier catching her breath by a water tank, city lights below

app.brief: a budgeting app for freelancers: invoices in, tax set aside, what is safe to spend

theme.direction: swiss grid, off-white, one ink green, big numerals

app.copy:
PAGE home "Ledgerleaf — Home": what the app does
  [hero] Know what is safe to spend — Ledgerleaf sets tax aside the moment an invoice is paid.
  [stats] 31 percent set aside on average / 4 minutes a week
PAGE app "Ledgerleaf — Dashboard": the dashboard
  [list] Invoices / Tax pot / Safe to spend
PAGE pricing "Ledgerleaf — Pricing": pricing
  [price] 9 dollars a month — First two months free.
images: a freelancer at a kitchen table with a laptop and a shoebox of receipts
a close view of a hand holding a paid invoice

clips.what: a scroll through the dashboard: invoices, the tax pot filling, safe to spend
clips.label: Live

folio.brief: the portfolio of an illustrator who paints night markets

theme.direction: ink and watercolour, deep indigo, paper grain, quiet

folio.copy:

  [hero] Night markets, painted from memory — Lagos, Taipei, Oaxaca.

  [bio] I draw the hour after closing — Fifteen years of sketchbooks, one stall at a time.

  [list] Giclée prints / Signed, 50 each / Ships rolled
